contents: For MAPPO, IPPO, FF-MAPPO, FF-IPPO and QMIX: the raw actor layout, the raw learner-state layout (4 games, blocks of 4 rounds) and the raw collection details, as training.checkpoints._layout and _collection_details produced them at the source commit
purpose: The raw values behind tests/fixtures/method_contracts.json's digests (each raw value hashes to its committed digest), so the method-contract test can allow only the listed Red Zone differences and check everything else exactly.
